summary: Tested Emergent Google Auth integration on GreenFork Partner Panel — all 6 requested items (4 backend + 2 frontend) pass. Backend pytest suite (4/4 green) validates 400 on missing X-Session-ID, 401 on missing auth for /me, valid seeded token returns user JSON with user_id/email/name/picture and no _id, and logout removes the Mongo session so subsequent /me returns 401. Playwright verified unauthenticated root redirects to /login with the Continue-with-Google button, injecting seeded session_token cookie loads /overview with sidebar user-name populated, and logout button returns to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores expires_at as ISO string on insert but auth code correctly reparses — consistent, no action needed.
logout endpoint always returns {ok: true} even for anonymous requests; not a bug but consider 401 if token missing for stricter semantics.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/session — acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: Seeded via mongosh — SESSION_TOKEN=test_session_1787832355202, USER_ID=test-user-1787832355202 in test_database.users/user_sessions. Additional pytest fixtures create/tear-down their own tokens.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 user + 1 session in Mongo (test_database) via mongosh for Playwright cookie injection; pytest fixtures seed & cleanup their own docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth integration is fully working. Cookie is httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None so Playwright cookie injection must include those flags exactly. Frontend routes: / -> redirects to /overview if authed, else /login. data-testids used: google-signin-button, user-name, logout-button.
